pain_point: Commute and location concerns - I need something close to the freeway and port — Truganina ticks that box but is it too far west?
headline_pain: Still Renting Closer to the City?
headline_outcome: Own a Warehouse on the Freeway
primary_text: "Truganina ticks that box but is it too far west?" Here's what business owners who moved west discovered: faster freight routes, lower overheads, and a warehouse they own outright. Truganina is 20km from Melbourne CBD with Princes Freeway at your doorstep and the Port of Melbourne a short drive away. Over 50 businesses have already made the switch to Melbourne's fastest-growing industrial corridor. The West Gate Tunnel is cutting travel times even further. These off-the-plan warehouses are built for owner-occupiers who want location without the price tag of older suburbs. See why Truganina is where smart operators are heading.
description: Located in Melbourne's fastest-growing western industrial corridor
